In their place were ten thousand volumes: histories of Aethelgard, treatises on botanical alchemy, and leather-bound notebooks filled with Elena\u2019s meticulous transcriptions of Earth\u2019s literature, poetry, engineering principles, and philosophy.</p><p>She had built an archive that would preserve the best of both worlds.</p><p>&quot;You&#x27;re working too hard, my Queen,&quot; a voice whispered against the back of her neck.</p><p>A pair of strong, familiar arms wrapped around her waist, pulling her back against a broad, solid chest. Vaelen rested his chin on her shoulder, his silver eyes warm and bright with contented peace. He was dressed simply in a charcoal silk tunic and black trousers, having discarded his royal mantle the moment the day&#x27;s council sessions concluded.</p><p>Elena leaned into his embrace, sighing softly as his thumbs gently traced the sides of her waist.</p><p>&quot;I&#x27;m not working,&quot; she replied, turning her head to press a kiss to his jawline. &quot;I&#x27;m organizing the curriculum for the academy. Kaelen wants us to introduce a course on modern diplomatic history. He thinks Earth&#x27;s treaties are fascinating.&quot;</p><p>&quot;Kaelen is a romantic scout who spends too much time reading love sonnets,&quot; Vaelen chuckled, his chest vibrating against her back. &quot;Let him teach diplomacy. As long as he keeps our eastern borders secure, he can recite poetry to the trees for all I care.&quot;</p><p>Elena laughed, turning in his arms to face him. She rested her hands on the lapels of his tunic, looking up into his handsome, aristocratic face. The dark circles that had shadowed his eyes for centuries were completely gone. The razor-sharp edge of the brooding warlord had softened into the quiet, confident grace of a sovereign who was deeply, undeniably loved.</p><p>&quot;Walk with me onto the terrace,&quot; she said softly. &quot;The sun is rising.&quot;</p><p></p><div class=\"break\">\u2726 \u2726 \u2726</div><p></p><p>They stepped out onto the Grand Obsidian Terrace, three hundred feet above the city.</p><p>The morning air was crisp and scented with pine, sea salt, and blooming jasmine. To the east, the sun crested over the serrated ridges of the northern mountains, sending lances of pure gold light dancing across the black glass roofs of the capital.</p><p>The city shimmered like a jewel.</p><p>Vaelen stood beside her at the carved stone balustrade, his fingers loosely intertwined with hers. On their fingers, the twin crowns of House Thorne\u2014his of black star-glass, hers of sun-gold\u2014caught the morning rays in harmonic brilliance.</p><p>&quot;Sometimes,&quot; Vaelen said quietly, gazing out over the peaceful realm, &quot;I still wake in the dark and check my ribs to ensure the nightmare is truly over. I spent four hundred years believing this world was cursed to rot in silence.&quot;</p><p>Elena squeezed his hand. &quot;It wasn&#x27;t cursed, Vaelen. It was just waiting for someone brave enough to tear down the walls.&quot;</p><p>Vaelen turned to face her, his silver eyes reflecting the golden dawn. He lifted her hand to his lips, kissing her knuckles with that familiar, heart-stopping reverence.</p><p>&quot;It was waiting for you, Elena,&quot; he murmured. &quot;You were the spark. You tore down my walls first.&quot;</p><p>Elena smiled, a mysterious, tender warmth blooming in her hazel eyes. She took his hand and slowly, deliberately guided his large, calloused palm down from her waist, resting it flat over the gentle curve of her lower abdomen.</p><p>Vaelen stilled.</p><p>His brow furrowed slightly in confusion. &quot;Elena? What is\u2014&quot;</p><p>He stopped.</p><p>Through the Blood-Tether, a new sensation rippled across the link.</p><p>It was faint, delicate, and impossibly sweet\u2014like the flutter of a sparrow\u2019s wing inside an eggshell.</p><p>*Thump... thump... thump...*</p><p>It was a heartbeat.</p><p>A tiny, third pulse, beating in rapid, rhythmic harmony beneath Elena\u2019s navel.</p><p>Vaelen\u2019s breath caught in his throat. His silver eyes dilated in sudden, breathtaking shock. His hand trembled against her stomach, spreading his long fingers wide as if terrified the fragile rhythm would vanish if he pressed too hard.</p><p>&quot;Elena...&quot; his voice cracked, a whisper of pure, unadulterated awe. &quot;Is that...&quot;</p><p>&quot;A little prince,&quot; Elena whispered, her eyes shining with joyous tears as she covered his hand with her own. &quot;Or a little princess. The court healers confirmed it this morning.&quot;</p><p>Vaelen dropped to his knees on the stone terrace.</p><p>He buried his face against her belly, his strong arms wrapping around her hips, holding her with a gentleness so profound it stole the breath from her chest. Elena felt the hot moisture of his tears soaking through the fine linen of her dress.</p><p>The lethal Commander of the Umbral Guard, the Sovereign of the Obsidian Throne, was weeping like a boy before a miracle.</p><p>&quot;A child...&quot; Vaelen choked out, his voice muffled against her skin. &quot;Our child... born of shadow and dawn.&quot;</p><p>Elena ran her fingers through his dark, thick hair, smiling down at him as the golden morning light bathed them both in warmth.</p><p>&quot;They will never know chains, Vaelen,&quot; she whispered softly. &quot;They will never know cold towers, blood-tethers, or cruel kings. They will grow up in the light.&quot;</p><p>Vaelen lifted his head, his face wet with tears, his silver eyes glowing with a fierce, incandescent love that spanned worlds and lifetimes.</p><p>He reached up, cupping her cheeks in his hands, pulling her down for a kiss that tasted of sweet morning dew, tears of joy, and a future brighter than the sun.</p><p>&quot;Soul to soul,&quot; he swore against her lips, the ancient covenant ringing true for an eternity. &quot;Breath to breath. Through the void, and beyond death.&quot;</p><p>&quot;Soul to soul,&quot; Elena answered, resting her forehead against his as the bells of Aethelgard began to ring in celebration of a new day.</p><p>The tether was no longer a chain of smoke and sin.</p><p>It was an unbroken ribbon of light, binding their souls together across eternity.</p><p>\nLater that afternoon, Elena walked hand-in-hand with Vaelen through the bustling gardens of the newly restored Academy of the Eclipse.</p><p>Young mortals\u2014the sons and daughters of the liberated captives\u2014sat on the stone benches beneath blooming jasmine arbors, reading leather-bound treatises on astronomy, medicine, and geometry alongside young shadow-fae nobles. Where there had once been centuries of suspicion, bloodshed, and fear, there was now the eager exchange of ideas, laughter, and mutual discovery.</p><p>Kaelen stood near the sundial in the center of the courtyard, patiently demonstrating the mechanics of an Earth-style magnetic compass to a circle of wide-eyed fae scouts.</p><p>&quot;You see?&quot; Kaelen was saying with great animated gestures. &quot;No magic required! Just a needle of magnetized iron seeking the polar north! Truly, mortal intellect is a formidable sorcery of its own!&quot;</p><p>Elena caught Kaelen\u2019s eye, smiling warmly as the scout snapped a crisp fist over his heart in salute to his Queen.</p><p>&quot;Look at what we built, Vaelen,&quot; Elena whispered, resting her head against his shoulder as they paused beside a stone fountain where turquoise water danced in the sunlight.</p><p>Vaelen turned to her, wrapping his arms around her waist, pulling her flush against his chest. People don&#x27;t need magic to be happy. They just need knowledge, peace, and someone who believes in them.&quot;</p><p>Vaelen stopped his hands, looking down into her hazel eyes with unshielded devotion.</p><p>&quot;You gave them that, Elena,&quot; he whispered, leaning down to press a soft kiss to her lips. &quot;You gave me that.&quot;</p><p>Elena reached up, wrapping her arms around his neck, pulling him down until their foreheads rested together.</p><p>The gentle breeze blew through the open terrace, carrying the fragrance of blooming jasmine and sun-roses. High above in the clear twilight sky, the twin moons appeared\u2014no longer symbols of dark omens, but luminous guardians of an unbroken peace.</p><p>The Blood-Tether hummed softly between them\u2014a golden, unbreakable melody of two souls bound forever in love, honor, and eternity.</p><p>\nAs the evening bells of Aethelgard began their gentle, musical chime across the sunlit valley, Elena and Vaelen stood at the balustrade of the high terrace, watching the first stars of evening ignite in the rose-violet sky.</p><p>Below them, the city was alive with peaceful music and laughter.</p><p>Vaelen wrapped his cloak around both of their shoulders, keeping the cool twilight breeze from Elena\u2019s skin.         let currentIdx = 0;

        const themes = ['', 'sepia', 'light'];

        function init() {
            const sel = document.getElementById('chapterSelect');
            chapters.forEach((ch, i) => {
                const opt = document.createElement('option');
                opt.value = i;
                opt.textContent = `Ch ${ch.num}: ${ch.title.split(': ')[1] || ch.title} (${ch.words.toLocaleString()}w)`;
                sel.appendChild(opt);
            });
            renderChapter(0);
        }

        function renderChapter(idx) {
            currentIdx = idx;
            const ch = chapters[idx];
            document.getElementById('chapterSelect').value = idx;
            document.getElementById('dispTitle').textContent = ch.title;
            document.getElementById('dispMeta').textContent = `Chapter ${ch.num} of ${chapters.length} • ${ch.words.toLocaleString()} words`;
            document.getElementById('footerPage').textContent = `Chapter ${ch.num} of ${chapters.length}`;
            document.getElementById('contentArea').innerHTML = ch.html;
            
            document.getElementById('btnPrev').disabled = (idx === 0);
            document.getElementById('btnNext').disabled = (idx === chapters.length - 1);
            window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
        }

        function goToChapter(idx) { renderChapter(idx); }
        function prevChapter() { if (currentIdx > 0) renderChapter(currentIdx - 1); }
        function nextChapter() { if (currentIdx < chapters.length - 1) renderChapter(currentIdx + 1); }

        function cycleTheme() {
            themeIdx = (themeIdx + 1) % themes.length;
            document.body.className = themes[themeIdx];
        }

        function toggleFont() {
            isSerif = !isSerif;
            document.body.style.fontFamily = isSerif ? '"Georgia", serif' : '-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif';
        }

        window.onload = init;
    </script>
</body>

# Chapter 1: Chapter 1

Aurelia's nimble hands made quick work of the vials, a symphony of stoppered glass and liquid thrumming against her palms as she prepared the next step in her ritual - the precise dilution of viper venom to enhance potency. Under the candelabra's soft glow, shadows cast by the flickering flames made her pupils narrow with concentration. Her blood-bespattered apron spoke volumes about the trials within these lab walls; tiny scars on her wrists throbbed faintly in rhythm with her racing heart.

Suddenly, the heavy wooden door to her chamber slammed open with vicious force, leaving splinters in its wake and sending the lit candles toppling like jack-in-the-box skeletons. 

"Priestess, attend me!"

Aloft in the chaos, an obsidian figure stood shrouded head-to-toe in crimson velvet and raven-black leather, his face obscured beneath ornate gold filigree - the blindfold that ensnared the throne alongside the sword and axe he wielded. Eyes invisible behind the hammered plates drank in every inch of her exposed skin with unblinking lust and fury.

With a deft shift of weight, the executioner prince descended among her scattered beakers and shattered vials with predatory grace, each step echoing off the stone like a death knell on funeral march. Beneath his boots, crushed shards bit into her wood floorboards like jagged fangs.  

"You...dare..."

Aurelia's voice wavered on the precipice of a scream even as she fought for composure, venom-tinged eyes flashing at the calculated destruction before her. She brandished her glassware and flasks as weapons in futile defiance - this trespasser was not one to cower under her stare or be swayed by threats.

Caelum raised a gloved hand, allowing the smallest whisper of movement as if he might pluck petals from a flower, only his were crafted to reap lives rather than nurture them. "Your services are...REQUIRED. By the crown." 

Each word, a slow, deliberate cutting blow honed sharper with every repetition until it formed a sentence straight from hell itself, one dripping in implied suffering and dire consequences for refusal - his fingers flexed, readying to strangle meaning from silence should that become necessary.

As the tension crackled between venomous words and drawn blades like live wire stretched taut, only one truth remained crystal clear to both participants - whatever role she played for him this night, there was no escape from his gravitational pull or the collision course of their destinies fast hurtling toward cataclysmic union.

✦ ✦ ✦

Crimson droplets splattered across worn boards as Aurelia's precious elixirs shattered, seeping into fine webbing of cracks carved ages ago by unknown feet. She recoiled, gaze raking over shattered remains of vials and test tubes strewn carelessly in an arc of ruin, like sacrificial offerings laid bare upon blood-soaked stone altars. Caelum stood before her, impassive behemoth forged in midnight steel and obsidian starlight. His silhouette cast no shadows; instead, it seemed the very darkness coalesced around him, solidified, taking on a life of its own to clothe his form. With uncanny stillness, each measured tread silenced any protest or outrage bubbling within the depths of her throat.

As venomous amber sparks flashed in her stare, challenging those black voids concealing his thoughts, Caelum let his weight settle deeper into his boots. He could almost feel the chill seep through wooden planks into the stone below, sensing the raw energy coursing through her like a tempest threatening to spill beyond containment. That was part of his allure – the primal awareness of power barely leashed. And he had come to claim what rightfully belonged to the Crown – however elusive or entwined with secrecy these services had become in the shadows.

"You...will obey," Aurelia hissed past gritted teeth, an imperceptible tremor rippling behind her words as she squared shoulders against the onslaught of his presence. Her slender frame seemed utterly insignificant beneath the weight of his relentless gaze, yet she held ground – a stubborn flame refusing to gutter despite buffeting malevolent winds. Those eyes flashed once more, twin jewels of molten gold, promising swift retribution should he press further upon already frayed nerve endings. Yet for all her bluster, Caelum detected a flicker of unease trembling just beneath the surface of that defiant facade – an unspoken fear that even her mastery of poisons might prove insufficient against a foe armed with the throne's wrath and unfathomable resources, should she dare cross the crown prince.

The executioner let his gloved hand hover an inch from her throat – mere suggestion of force enough to ensure compliance amid whispers of silk, leather, and tempered steel caressing delicate skin should he choose to tighten his grip that half-span. "Your skills will serve..." he paused, savoring her rising alarm as anticipation coursed through his veins like scalding wine - "...at tonight's ceremony. In honor of Solara. Part of her yearned to be strong, unyielding, to prove she wasn't fazed by any amount of death or darkness this forsaken world flung at her. But another hungered for comfort, for shelter from the storm gathering within these labyrinthine halls and threatening to crush her very being beneath its weight. In that moment of breathtaking loneliness, none seemed clearer than one man—a tall, imposing silhouette framed by the jagged mouth of an arched doorway as a distant bell tolled mournfully in the cathedral above.

With a silent, anguished moan, Aurelia shoved aside years of conditioning, layers of steel-reinforced habituation that always left her oddly unsatisfied despite achieving peak performance. Steeling herself against exhaustion, cold dread sinking heavily in her belly that weighed almost as much as the twin wounds crisscrossing her torso, she instead focused intently on the phantom warmth generated by Caelum's hold. His palm drifted up to brush hair wisped away from her cheek, fingers grazing her temple in maddeningly gentle strokes meant solely for soothing, not seduction, as if to assuage her fears.

✦ ✦ ✦

The warm press of Caelum's fingertips softened Aurelia's gaze, drawing her attention into the curve of his palm like a moth to a flame. Time lost meaning as those slow, exquisite caresses replaced every other sensation—pounding heart, shallow gasps, heavy thighs trembling with the urge to surrender, to give in. 

But just as swiftly, fragile trust shattered as another sound pierced the hushed chamber—an agonized shriek tearing through the air, abruptly cutting the fragile spell that had bonded them. The prince froze, brows drawn into a sharp V, as a frantic patter echoed closer, growing louder before skidding to a stop before their bench.

"Holy Mother," someone breathed, voice shaking like autumn leaves. "Look what they did... "

Slowly, Aurelia levered herself upright on shaky legs, pain hammering through her midsection with each clumsy movement until raw agony blurred vision and dulled thought. But even through the haze, a horrifying image took shape—misshapen body crumpled against the far wall where the scream originated, blood painting the tile floor an obscene crimson pool.

Golden light spilled inward as the cathedral doors lurched open, and Prince Orion strode in, expression ashen. A small crowd clustered behind him: scholars in rumpled robes, priests clutching intricately carved prayer bones, all cast anxious glances between the grisly tableau and the newly arisen pair. 

"This isn't possible," Orion declared hoarsely, gaze riveting on the mutilated form at their feet. "Vasilisa Blackwood, a woman of unparalleled cunning and power, has been reduced to...this."

Pain flared like a gypsy fire through Aurelia's chest as she shifted to face her brother—a subtle tightening of muscles perhaps, but Orion's eyes widened, alarm flashing across his countenance as he recoiled involuntarily.

"Dear gods," he whispered, face blanching anew. "Aurelia—your wounds! How can you..."

No words mattered anymore. Fractured thoughts swirled to oblivion beneath a red haze of rage tempered only by searing grief. Bitter bile scorched the back of Aurelia's throat as she lunged for her broken sister, faltering steps eating at her own flesh like acid, yet driven onward by primitive maternal need.

"Vasilisa!" she wept, collapsing beside the corpselike figure. Crimson stained Aurelia's tears as desperate fingers combed matted black hair, searching for the spark of life amidst the viscera spilling out onto the stones.

Yet amidst the horror, something strange stirred deep within her chest—a sense alien and yet not unfamiliar, echoing eerily the pulse of the celestial machinery spinning unseen above. As if awakening from centuries-long slumber, ancient magic kindled to life. Aurelia felt it thrumming through her veins like a living inferno, each ragged breath exhaling scorching tendris around her.

And then, the final, shattering realization: Aurelia was no ordinary viperess. Whatever horrors Kira and Malakai sought would merely speed this transformation along, fueling her ascension toward powers beyond mortal comprehension.

As the world narrowed to nothingness around her—sound fading, light dimming, senses retreating into some primal core—"Sister" became a redundant term in Aurelia Vex's mind. One serpent soul would soon swallow the rest.

This new goddess would rise from the ashes—the Serpent Empress—reborn from death itself. And her first act of dominion would be ushered forth with Prince Corvin's dying kiss...

# Chapter 45: Chapter 45

Cold marble dug cruelly into tender flesh where Aurelia collapsed, her cradling arms no shield against the unforgiving floor. Sharp agony lanced up her arm, but distant, insignificant compared to the void gouging away pieces of her soul with each anguished sob. She huddled over Vasilisa's gore-splattered wreckage, barely registering the slickness coating her own limbs—a macabre mosaic of crimson and viscous black.

As reality bleached white around her, one truth alone propelled her limp form forward—to wrap herself completely around this violated husk, bury everything inside the familiar contours until they blended into one desolate creature.

Fingers found her sister's matted locks and tangled deep, searching. Blindly, desperately, frantically, ignoring the jagged edges shredding her own skin. Each futile caress only confirmed what screaming terror already knew—there wouldn't be a gentle stirring or warm pulse emanating from this shredded corpse.

Yet even as madness clawed at the borders of reality, something...shifted. Within the storm-tossed depths of her psyche, the distant thrumming grew louder—a low hum that began as background static before surging to dominate all else. Her heart, still battering the confines of her ribs like a caged animal, developed a queer rhythm attuned to some vast, ethereal cadence.

The infernal brand on her chest burned hotter, throbbing almost painfully between gasping breaths that carried the acrid scent of ozone. Aurelia knew, without looking, that tendrils of shimmering plasma were curling from the sigil's central sigil, tracing the path of her tear-blessed cheeks down the expanse of her torso, leaving glistening rivulets in their wake.

Cleansing, yet corrupting, just like the darkness itself.

In this dizzying pivot, from agonized despair to nascent triumph, time lost meaning. Aurelia stopped tracking hours and moments—a meaningless construct in this burgeoning realm of immortal rebirth. All that existed were the ebb and flow of power, sensations so intense her nerve endings practically screamed, pulsing waves of transformative energy that threatened to consume her whole.

And through it all, a single thought crystallized:

Corvin was next. This exquisite shell housing his royal blood wouldn't last long under Kira and Mal the Butcher's relentless assault. Soon enough, he'd tumble victim to the same unyielding malevolence that had silenced her sisters. His screams would pierce the night like silvered daggers aimed squarely at Aurelia's core. Watching him fight valiantly only to be shredded—broken—and discarded, piece by agonizing piece—all because of what she'd become...

No. Not if she could help it. At any cost, even defiling the purity of the divine flame coursing through her veins, she would not let the prince die as Vasilisa had.

His lips upon hers, a last defiant gesture before the merciful annihilation of eternal sleep—no. That kiss had spoken volumes regarding Corvin's feelings, making Aurelia's resolution absolute.

She would ascend using every ounce of celestial power, but she refused to relinquish her claim on the High Executioner—and with it, his destiny. Their fates, once so hopelessly entwined by mutual pursuit and hatred, became inextricably linked by the sheer scope of Aurelia's emerging might and ambition.

This path chose her, not the other way around. Now, having taken the first irrevocable step toward becoming the dreaded Serpent Empress, there could be no turning back from the hellfire waiting to engulf both Vortex Academy.

✦ ✦ ✦

The acrid scent of smoke curled up into Aurelia's nostrils, singeing her nasal passages and making them water. Shattered glass crunched beneath her boots as she stood at the edge of the demolished library, its charred remains a grim testament to her newfound strength unleashed upon her enemies. Only moments ago, those ancient tomes had housed secrets ripe for the taking—if she were to endure this chaos. 

But none of the destruction mattered more than preserving Prince Caelum's life. He lay prone behind her, unconscious yet vital, dragged out of the brutal melee by desperate hands. Blood seeped steadily from numerous wounds, staining his white tunic crimson as it pooled faintly around him in the flickering torchlight.

Aurelia felt each drop as if cut from her own flesh—the guilt, the anguish, the primal maternal urge to shield him from all harm. She dared not bend to tend his injuries herself; risking contact would only heighten the perilous pull between them, tempting fate with repercussions dire and delicious. Instead, she focused on constructing a shelter, erecting a makeshift barrier of crates and drapery, praying it would hold against the onslaught long enough for the prince to recover sufficiently to escape.

"You can't keep running forever," came a mocking whisper near her ear, sending shivers down her spine.

She whirled, fist clenched and dripping malice, to face Corvin. Though injured and clearly exhausted, he still exuded an aura of ruthless authority. Behind the mask of blood splatters and grit, his gaze remained fixed unwaveringly upon her, an unsettling intensity burning brighter in the darkness.

"Oh? And what should I do instead, Your Highness?" Aurelia shot back, each word laced with cold venom and contempt. "Kneel before you and plead for mercy while my sisters weep over their butchered bodies?"

"Better than rotting in your own self-imposed purgatory." He took a faltering step closer, pain ravaging his features but determination set in iron. "We're not so different, you and I. Seek to dominate the world...at any cost."

"Spare me your hypocritical moralism," she spat. "At least I don't serve gods who crave human sacrifice!"

"A necessary evil for a higher cause!" Corvin barked, his grip on her upper arm tightening like a vice. A jolt ran through her at the sudden, electrifying contact—a reminder of the potent chemistry crackling just beneath the surface, threatening to detonate into raw, brutal passion whenever they touched. "Unlike your blood magic and twisted obsessions."

"It's not 'blood magic,'" Aurelia hissed, struggling against his grasp with all her might. "It's my birthright! My legacy!" She reveled in the exquisite friction of his fingers digging into her flesh as she wrenched free, the act leaving her skin tinged with bruise marks already forming. It was a small defiance amidst the chaos, worth savoring, even at the cost of further enraging her nemesis.

Caelum chose that moment to groan weakly, drawing both attackers' attention. Aurelia's heart stuttered as Corvin swiftly repositioned himself between the two of them, positioning his limp body like a human shield. She recognized this stance—one meant to intimidate and assert dominance—with dread recognition. Each breath sounded tortured, hinting at his dwindling tolerance.

"So..." Corvin began, his words laced with the menace of a cornered animal, red-rimmed eyes locked onto hers. "Are you going to finish me off now or try to rescue your plaything?"

✦ ✦ ✦

Aurelia's heart pounded wildly as Corvin turned his wrathful gaze upon her, crouched protectively over Caelum's battered form like a predator about to strike. His rancor dripped from each word, seeping into her veins, setting her nerves alight with anticipatory terror.

"Unhand him," she commanded, every fiber of her being screaming to charge forward and tear Corvin away by force if necessary—but restraint dictated prudence here. If she so much as raised a hand...

Inching closer, she let out a slow exhale, attempting to soften her stance, to show Corvin without speaking that she meant no harm, now that he held her lover as leverage. "Please, Corvin... release him. Let's end this peacefully."

Corvin released a humorless snort, the sound harsh and derisive. "Peacefully?" He raised an eyebrow, incredulity lacing his tone. "Is that what you call it when I've had to endure your sick little games and twisted obsession for years behind these walls? You won't get away with hurting your precious prince, not when I've seen beneath all these—"

He gestured violently, nearly toppling Caelum in the process.

"—pretty lies and painted smiles. Not after the things you do in the dead of night."

The accusation hung heavy in the air, weighted with a cruel accuracy that stole Aurelia's breath. He knew far too much, his intuition cutting deeper than any blade. Her pale cheeks flamed red, the secret of her nocturnal exploits hovering precariously close to exposure.

"D-don't speak of those things," she managed to choke out, trying to keep her voice steady despite the icy dread creeping up her spine. Each heartbeat thundered in her ears, threatening to drown out reason.

"What you don't understand—" she took another cautious step forward, desperation etching her features, every muscle poised for flight or battle—

"what you can never comprehend, Corvin, is how desperately I crave peace after centuries adrift in this unending war within myself!"

Her words burst forth like a pent-up tempest, raw candor and anguish merging into an explosive plea. Tears glazed her eyes, reflecting the flickering torchlight as emotion overwhelmed her control, shredding her usual composed facade in its wake.

"I'm tired of battling these... cravings, these feelings that consume everything else!" Struggling against the torrent of sensation clawing at her senses, she dug her nails into her palms until they bled, the pain focusing fragments of her scattered thoughts. "I need balance, some respite from this endless cycle of hunger and despair, but it terrifies me because..."

Because deep down, she yearned for Caelum's shadowy presence, his blindfolded intensity and whispered darkness.

"I lust after your cold indifference and sterile silence," Aurelia confessed, her voice cracking on the admission.

"Oh God." A trembling sob escaped her lips before she could stifle it. Horror and humiliation warred as she cringed inwardly, realizing how vulnerable she'd become in this moment of unshielded truth.

"Stop... stop speaking such madness, Vex," Corvin demanded grimly, clearly torn between outrage and fascination over her sudden verbal spilling. "There's always been something wrong with you, but even—"

His words chopped abruptly off as Caelum stirred, a low, agonized moan escaping his parted lips. Aurelia rushed to his side, kneeling carefully and brushing back his dark hair to reveal the angry contusions marring his skin.

"Cael—!"

✦ ✦ ✦

Aurelia's blood-cooled fingers hesitated mere inches from bruised flesh swollen with silent suffering. Her gaze, once piercing emerald, now flickered uncertainly, lost as a ship without anchor amidst tempestuous seas. The admission just spilled had left her dizzy with shame, yet unable—or unwilling—to sever the unspoken threads binding her to her blindfolded companion.

As shock rippled through his tortured form, Caelum stirred again, a low, animalistic groan tearing past clenched teeth. His breathing grew ragged, the rhythmic strain underscoring each labored inhale and stifled exhale. Aurelia's hands moved instinctively, gentling the wayward strands of raven-black locks from bloodied skin etched with livid welts.

With a shuddering gasp, her attention fastened upon the cruel markings marbling his visage—staples, probably, hastily driven home during his fit by desperate, trembling hands. She traced the jagged lines reverently, a maddened whisper falling from her parted lips. "How could I not know? These... he did this."

Her words carried a note of dismay tinged with reluctant awe, an acknowledgment of the savage strength and unyielding ferocity that pulsed beneath Corvin's calculated savagery. As she peered closer, nearly nose to bruise, a frisson of morbid curiosity unfurled within her.

Those cruel marks weren't just testament to brutality; they were a gruesome map of twisted devotion. Each contusion, every stitch, bore vivid testimony to the lengths one might go in pursuit of an unconquerable fixation—much like the suffocating pull keeping Aurelia irrevocably ensnared in her own desires.

For an eternity held captive only in this fleeting instant, there remained no line dividing victor from vanquished—just two broken, blood-stained creatures tethered together via strings of pain and darkest, most forbidden desire.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
PRIME Moment Attention: Unified Empirical Reproduction Runner
=============================================================

Reproduces all empirical experiments documented in the scientific dossier:
  - Experiment A: Mathematical Taylor convergence and diagonal tensor error (D in {2, 4, 8})
  - Experiment B: 1-Million token context scaling benchmark (latency & memory)
  - Experiment C: Needle information survival curve vs unweighted ELU+1 linear attention
  - Experiment D: Multi-needle independent query retrieval across 2,048 tokens
  - Experiment E: State overwrite & belief revision dynamics
  - Experiment E2: Sequential multi-stage contradiction dynamics (BLUE -> RED -> GREEN -> YELLOW)
  - Experiment F: Differentiable multiscale timescale learning via backpropagation
  - Experiment F2: Three-condition timescale convergence (Fixed vs Learnable vs Random Init)
  - Experiment G: Long-rollout numerical stability across 2,048 autoregressive steps

Usage:
  python reproduce_all.py --all
  python reproduce_all.py --exp a
  python reproduce_all.py --exp b
  python reproduce_all.py --list
"""

import sys
import os
import argparse
import subprocess

EXPERIMENTS = {
    "a": ("exp_a_taylor_convergence.py", "Experiment A: Mathematical Taylor Convergence (D in {2, 4, 8})"),
    "b": ("exp_b_1m_context_scaling.py", "Experiment B: 1-Million Token Scaling Benchmark"),
    "c": ("exp_c_needle_retention.py", "Experiment C: Needle Information Retention vs ELU+1"),
    "d": ("exp_d_multi_needle_recall.py", "Experiment D: Multi-Needle Associative Recall"),
    "e": ("exp_e_state_overwrite.py", "Experiment E: State Overwrite & Contradiction Dynamics"),
    "e2": ("exp_e2_sequential_contradiction.py", "Experiment E2: Sequential Multi-Stage Contradiction Dynamics"),
    "f": ("exp_f_learnable_timescales.py", "Experiment F: Learnable Timescales via Backpropagation"),
    "f2": ("exp_f2_timescale_convergence.py", "Experiment F2: Three-Condition Timescale Convergence"),
    "g": ("exp_g_long_rollout_stability.py", "Experiment G: 2048-Step Rollout Numerical Stability"),
    "h": ("exp_h_prime_selective.py", "Experiment H: 100% PRIME-Selective Distillation Engine (1.5B)"),
    "i": ("exp_i_deep_hook_telemetry.py", "Experiment I: Deep Hook Telemetry & Multi-Battery Diagnostic Harness"),
    "j": ("exp_j_domain1_vision_clip_dinov2.py", "Experiment J: Domain 1 - Multimodal Vision (CLIP ViT-B/32 & DINOv2)"),
    "k": ("exp_k_domain2_audio_whisper.py", "Experiment K: Domain 2 - Speech Recognition (OpenAI Whisper-tiny)"),
    "l": ("exp_l_domain3_chronos_dynamics.py", "Experiment L: Domain 3 - Physical Dynamics (Amazon Chronos-T5-mini)"),
    "m": ("exp_m_domain4_chemberta_molecules.py", "Experiment M: Domain 4 - Cheminformatics (ChemBERTa-77M-MTR)"),
    "n": ("exp_n_domain5_decision_transformer.py", "Experiment N: Domain 5 - Offline RL & Continuous Control (Decision Transformer)"),
    "o": ("exp_o_protein_folding_esm2.py", "Experiment O: Structural Biology - Protein Folding (ESM-2 150M)"),
    "p": ("exp_p_diffusion_llm_mdlm.py", "Experiment P: Discrete Diffusion LLMs (MDLM NeurIPS 2024)"),
    "q": ("exp_q_image_diffusion_sd15.py", "Experiment Q: 2D Spatial Image Diffusion (Stable Diffusion 1.5)"),
    "r": ("exp_r_video_diffusion_animatediff.py", "Experiment R: Temporal Video Diffusion (AnimateDiff v1.5-2)"),
    "s": ("exp_s_trunk_matrix_decision_transformer.py", "Experiment S: Decision Transformer Trunk Substitution Matrix (6x3 Grid)"),
    "t": ("exp_t_trunk_matrix_chronos.py", "Experiment T: Amazon Chronos Trunk Substitution Matrix (7x3 Grid)"),
    "u": ("exp_u_dt_brutal_controls.py", "Experiment U: Decision Transformer Brutal Controls (Random, Zero, Shuffled)"),
    "v": ("exp_v_chronos_regularization_sweep.py", "Experiment V: Chronos Layer 1 Regularization Sweep across 10 Physical Regimes"),
    "w": ("exp_w_chronos_attention_diagnostic.py", "Experiment W: Chronos Causal Attention Mechanism & Noise Diagnostic"),
    "x": ("exp_x_prime_order_phase_diagram.py", "Experiment X: 42-Cell PRIME Order Response Surface & Phase Diagram"),
    "y": ("exp_y_adaptive_prime_evaluation.py", "Experiment Y: Adaptive PRIME Dynamic Contextual Bandwidth Routing"),
}

def run_experiment(exp_key: str):
    key = exp_key.lower()
    if key not in EXPERIMENTS:
        print(f"Unknown experiment: {exp_key}. Available: {list(EXPERIMENTS.keys())}")
        return False
    
    script_name, title = EXPERIMENTS[key]
    script_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "experiments", script_name)
    
    print("\n" + "=" * 80)
    print(f"RUNNING: {title}")
    print(f"SCRIPT:  {script_path}")
    print("=" * 80 + "\n")
    
    res = subprocess.run([sys.executable, script_path])
    return res.returncode == 0

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Reproduce PRIME Moment Attention Empirical Benchmarks")
    parser.add_argument("--all", action="store_true", help="Run all empirical experiments sequentially")
    parser.add_argument("--exp", type=str, help="Run a specific experiment (a, b, c, d, e, e2, f, f2, g)")
    parser.add_argument("--list", action="store_true", help="List all available experiments")
    
    args = parser.parse_args()
    
    if args.list:
        print("\nAvailable Empirical Reproduction Experiments:")
        for k, (s, desc) in EXPERIMENTS.items():
            print(f"  --exp {k:<3}: {desc}")
        print()
        return
        
    if args.all:
        for k in sorted(EXPERIMENTS.keys()):
            success = run_experiment(k)
            if not success:
                print(f"[!] Experiment {k} encountered an error.")
        print("\n[+] All requested benchmarks completed.")
    elif args.exp:
        run_experiment(args.exp)
    else:
        parser.print_help()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# 🔭 PRIME-Scout: Autonomous Local AI Repository Intelligence Agent

**PRIME-Scout** is a specialized, autonomous local research agent designed to run on your workstation. It actively scans GitHub for new and trending repositories aligning with your research interests (linear attention, ROCm/CUDA kernels, sub-quadratic transformers, Triton compilers, continuous memory, and decision transformers).

PRIME-Scout clones candidate repositories into an **isolated local execution sandbox**, audits hardware kernels and Python syntax, smoke-tests imports, evaluates technical viability using your **local GPU LLM (Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B)**, and synthesizes a high-signal **Daily Intelligence Briefing** alongside an **interactive web dashboard**.

---

## 📁 File System Layout

The directory structure is organized for transparency and ease of inspection:

```
PRIME-Moment-Attention/scout/
├── config.py                 # Target research interests, keywords, thresholds
├── github_client.py          # GitHub API search & code fetcher
├── database.py               # SQLite persistence vault (repositories & evaluations)
├── sandbox.py                # Isolated execution sandbox (git clone, AST audit, smoke tests)
├── evaluator.py              # Local GPU LLM evaluation engine (Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B)
├── reporter.py               # Markdown daily briefing generator
├── web_ui.py                 # Modern dark-mode FastAPI web dashboard
├── scout_cli.py              # CLI entry point
│
├── reports/                  # [READING VAULT] Daily markdown briefings
│   ├── briefing_latest.md    # Always points to today's newest briefing
│   └── briefing_YYYY-MM-DD.md
├── vault/                    # [PERSISTENCE]
│   └── scout_vault.db        # SQLite database of all evaluated repos & scores
└── sandbox/
    └── active/               # [EXECUTION SANDBOX] Isolated repo checkouts for testing
```

---

## 🚀 Quickstart

### 1. Launch the Interactive Web Dashboard
```bash
python -m scout.scout_cli ui --port 7860
```
Open your browser at `http://localhost:7860`:
* **📰 Daily Briefing**: Read today's curated digest with score badges and deep dives.
* **🧪 Sandbox & Deep-Dive**: Paste *any* GitHub repository URL to trigger an on-demand clone, sandbox test, and LLM evaluation.
* **🏛️ Memory Vault**: Search and filter through all past evaluations.
* **📁 File System**: View and clean active sandbox checkouts.

### 2. Run Today's Discovery Pipeline Manually
```bash
python -m scout.scout_cli run --limit 5
```
Scans GitHub, clones candidates, executes sandbox tests, runs local model evaluations, and writes `scout/reports/briefing_YYYY-MM-DD.md`.

### 3. Test a Single Repository in the Sandbox
```bash
python -m scout.scout_cli test https://github.com/sustcsonglin/flash-linear-attention
```

### 4. Read Today's Briefing in Terminal
```bash
python -m scout.scout_cli report
```

---

## ⏰ Automated Daily Scheduling (Cron)

To have PRIME-Scout automatically run once a day (e.g. at 6:00 AM) and prepare your briefing before you start work:

```bash
crontab -e
```
Add the following entry:
```cron
0 6 * * * /home/phil/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/venv/bin/python /home/phil/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/PRIME-Moment-Attention/scout/scout_cli.py run --limit 5 >> /home/phil/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/PRIME-Moment-Attention/scout/vault/scout_cron.log 2>&1
```

---

## 🛡️ Sandbox Safety Features
* **Isolated subprocesses**: All smoke tests execute in isolated subprocesses with timeouts (30–45s).
* **AST Validation**: Python code is parsed into Abstract Syntax Trees before execution to catch syntax corruptions.
* **Disk Quota Control**: Clones use `--depth 1` to minimize bandwidth and storage. Active sandboxes can be purged with a single button in the Web UI or via `rm -rf scout/sandbox/active/*`.

"""
PRIME-Scout: Autonomous Background Research Daemon
Continuously operates in the background:
- Mines repository architectures and frontiers
- Formulates novel mathematical theories & conjectures
- Synthesizes isolated PyTorch micro-benchmarks
- Executes empirical experiments on ROCm/AMD GPU
- Records telemetry, benchmarks, and discoveries into scout_vault.db
- STRICT COMMIT BAN: NEVER COMMITS OR PUSHES TO GIT.
"""

import os
import sys
import time
import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from scout.config import SAFETY_POLICY
from scout.database import get_autonomous_state, update_autonomous_state
from scout.scientist import AutonomousScientist

def run_autonomous_daemon(interval_sec: float = 60.0):
    print("="*80)
    print("🔬 PRIME-Scout: Continuous Autonomous Science & Research Daemon")
    print(f"🔒 Safety Policy: ALLOW_GIT_COMMIT={SAFETY_POLICY['ALLOW_GIT_COMMIT']} (Commits strictly blocked)")
    print(f"⏱️  Pace: 1 cycle every {interval_sec} seconds (preserves GPU responsiveness)")
    print("="*80)

    scientist = AutonomousScientist()
    update_autonomous_state(is_active=1, current_action="RUNNING", current_target="Starting research loop")

    while True:
        try:
            state = get_autonomous_state()
            if not state.get("is_active", 1):
                print("[*] Autonomous engine is currently paused in database. Sleeping 10s...")
                time.sleep(10)
                continue

            cycle_start = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%H:%M:%S UTC")
            print(f"\n[+] [{cycle_start}] Initiating autonomous scientific inquiry...")
            
            result = scientist.run_full_discovery_and_theorize_cycle()
            print(f"[+] Result: {result['title']} -> {result['status']}")
            print(f"    Verdict: {result['conclusion']}")

        except (KeyboardInterrupt, SystemExit):
            print("\n[*] Autonomous research daemon shutting down cleanly.")
            update_autonomous_state(is_active=0, current_action="STOPPED", current_target="User interrupted")
            break
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"[!] Error in autonomous research cycle: {e}")
            update_autonomous_state(current_action="ERROR", current_target=str(e))

        print(f"[*] Cooldown: Sleeping {interval_sec}s before next hypothesis...")
        try:
            time.sleep(interval_sec)
        except (KeyboardInterrupt, SystemExit):
            print("\n[*] Exiting during cooldown.")
            break

if __name__ == "__main__":
    interval = float(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 60.0
    run_autonomous_daemon(interval_sec=interval)

"""
PRIME Autonomous Romantasy Studio Daemon
24/7 background engine that autonomously researches, outlines, writes,
enriches, packages (EPUB/PDF/HTML), and catalogs novels in the 50k to 250k word range.
"""

import sys
import time
import json
import sqlite3
import pathlib
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Dict, Any, List

PROJECT_ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(PROJECT_ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT_ROOT))

from scout.romantasy_studio import RomantasyStudio, NOVELS_ROOT, VAULT_DB_PATH
from scout.novel_researcher import RomantasyResearcher

def run_studio_daemon(cadence_seconds: float = 60.0):
    print("=" * 80)
    print("👑 PRIME Autonomous Romantasy Publishing Studio")
    print("✨ Multi-Book Factory: 50,000 to 250,000 Word Autonomous Production")
    print(f"⏱️  Heartbeat: Every {cadence_seconds:.1f}s")
    print("=" * 80)

    studio = RomantasyStudio()
    researcher = RomantasyResearcher()

    cycle = 1
    while True:
        try:
            now_str = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC")
            catalog = studio.get_library_catalog()

            print(f"\n[+] [{now_str}] Studio Cycle #{cycle}")
            active_book = None
            for b in catalog:
                status = b["status"]
                pct = round((b["current_words"] / b["target_words"]) * 100.0, 1) if b["target_words"] > 0 else 0.0
                print(f"    📚 [{status:11s}] {b['title'][:32]:32s} | {b['current_words']:,} / {b['target_words']:,}w ({pct}%) | Heat: {'🌶️'*b['heat_level']}")
                if status in ["RESEARCHING", "WRITING", "QUEUED"] and active_book is None:
                    active_book = b

            if active_book:
                slug = active_book["slug"]
                title = active_book["title"]
                status = active_book["status"]

                if status == "QUEUED":
                    print(f"\n[*] Initiating Autonomous Research Phase for: '{title}'...")
                    researcher.generate_research_dossier(slug)
                    conn = sqlite3.connect(VAULT_DB_PATH)
                    cur = conn.cursor()
                    cur.execute("UPDATE novel_library SET status = 'RESEARCHING' WHERE slug = ?;", (slug,))
                    conn.commit()
                    conn.close()

                elif status == "RESEARCHING":
                    print(f"\n[*] Generating Architectural Book Bible for: '{title}' ({active_book['target_words']:,} words, {active_book['total_chapters']} chapters)...")
                    # Build Book Bible
                    book_dir = NOVELS_ROOT / slug
                    book_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                    bible_p = book_dir / "BOOK_BIBLE.json"
                    
                    if not bible_p.exists():
                        dossier_p = book_dir / "RESEARCH_DOSSIER.json"
                        dossier = json.loads(dossier_p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if dossier_p.exists() else {}
                        
                        bible = {
                            "slug": slug,
                            "title": title,
                            "target_words": active_book["target_words"],
                            "total_chapters": active_book["total_chapters"],
                            "heat_level": active_book["heat_level"],
                            "subgenre": active_book["subgenre"],
                            "research_dossier": dossier.get("research_topics", {}),
                            "chapters": [
                                {
                                    "chapter": i + 1,
                                    "target_words": round(active_book["target_words"] / active_book["total_chapters"]),
                                    "act": 1 if i < active_book["total_chapters"] * 0.25 else (2 if i < active_book["total_chapters"] * 0.75 else 3),
                                    "status": "QUEUED"
                                }
                                for i in range(active_book["total_chapters"])
                            ]
                        }
                        bible_p.write_text(json.dumps(bible, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
                        print(f"[✓] Book Bible created at {bible_p}")

                    conn = sqlite3.connect(VAULT_DB_PATH)
                    cur = conn.cursor()
                    cur.execute("UPDATE novel_library SET status = 'WRITING' WHERE slug = ?;", (slug,))
                    conn.commit()
                    conn.close()

                elif status == "WRITING":
                    print(f"[*] Autonomous local writing pipeline active on '{title}'...")
                    book_dir = NOVELS_ROOT / slug
                    chapters_dir = book_dir / "chapters"
                    chapters_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

                    total_chapters = active_book["total_chapters"]
                    written_files = sorted(chapters_dir.glob("chapter_*.md"))
                    written_nums = set()
                    for f in written_files:
                        try:
                            num = int(f.stem.split("_")[1])
                            written_nums.add(num)
                        except Exception:
                            pass

                    next_ch = None
                    for ch_idx in range(1, total_chapters + 1):
                        if ch_idx not in written_nums:
                            next_ch = ch_idx
                            break

                    if next_ch is not None:
                        print(f"[*] [GPU Production] Drafting Chapter {next_ch}/{total_chapters} for '{title}' locally on AMD ROCm...")
                        from scout.prime_local_author import PrimeLocalAuthor
                        local_author = PrimeLocalAuthor()
                        ch_res = local_author.draft_chapter(slug, next_ch)

                        # Recalculate total words
                        all_chapters = sorted(chapters_dir.glob("chapter_*.md"))
                        total_words = sum(len(cf.read_text(encoding="utf-8").split()) for cf in all_chapters)
                        completed_count = len(all_chapters)

                        # Sync to SQLite
                        conn = sqlite3.connect(VAULT_DB_PATH)
                        cur = conn.cursor()
                        now_str = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
                        cur.execute("""
                        INSERT INTO novel_chapters (novel_title, chapter_number, title, word_count, content, status, created_at, updated_at)
                        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'COMPLETED', ?, ?)
                        ON CONFLICT(novel_title, chapter_number) DO UPDATE SET
                            word_count=excluded.word_count,
                            content=excluded.content,
                            updated_at=excluded.updated_at;
                        """, (title, next_ch, ch_res["title"], ch_res["words"], (chapters_dir / f"chapter_{next_ch:02d}.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8"), now_str, now_str))

                        new_status = "COMPLETED" if completed_count >= total_chapters else "WRITING"
                        cur.execute("""
                        UPDATE novel_library 
                        SET current_words = ?, completed_chapters = ?, status = ?, updated_at = ?
                        WHERE slug = ?;
                        """, (total_words, completed_count, new_status, now_str, slug))
                        conn.commit()
                        conn.close()
                        print(f"[✓] Synced Chapter {next_ch} to database. Novel total: {total_words:,} words ({completed_count}/{total_chapters} ch).")

                        # Auto-update Typeset PDF
                        try:
                            from scout.generate_sample_pdf import build_sample_pdf
                            pdf_p = build_sample_pdf(slug)
                            print(f"[✓] Automatically recompiled typeset PDF: {pdf_p.name}")
                        except Exception as pdf_err:
                            print(f"[!] PDF recompilation warning: {pdf_err}")
                    else:
                        print(f"[✓] All {total_chapters} chapters written for '{title}'! Marking COMPLETED.")
                        conn = sqlite3.connect(VAULT_DB_PATH)
                        cur = conn.cursor()
                        cur.execute("UPDATE novel_library SET status = 'COMPLETED' WHERE slug = ?;", (slug,))
                        conn.commit()
                        conn.close()

            cycle += 1
            time.sleep(cadence_seconds)

        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            print("\n[!] Studio daemon stopped by user.")
            break
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"[!] Studio cycle error: {e}")
            time.sleep(10.0)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    cadence = float(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 60.0
    run_studio_daemon(cadence)

"""
PRIME-Scout: Real-World NASA Battery Telemetry Loader
Loads and preprocesses real empirical measurements from the NASA Ames
Prognostics Center of Excellence (PCoE) Li-ion Battery Dataset (Cell B0005).
"""

import os
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, Any, List, Tuple, Optional
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

from scout.config import BASE_DIR

BATTERY_DATA_DIR = BASE_DIR / "scout" / "data" / "battery"
B0005_CSV_PATH = BATTERY_DATA_DIR / "B0005.csv"

class NasaBatteryLoader:
    def __init__(self, csv_path: Optional[Path] = None):
        self.csv_path = csv_path or B0005_CSV_PATH
        self._df: Optional[pd.DataFrame] = None

    def _ensure_loaded(self) -> pd.DataFrame:
        if self._df is None:
            if not self.csv_path.exists():
                raise FileNotFoundError(f"NASA Battery dataset not found at {self.csv_path}")
            self._df = pd.read_csv(self.csv_path)
        return self._df

    def get_capacity_fade_series(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Extracts real-world capacity fade trajectory across 168 discharge cycles.
        Returns:
        - cycles: list of cycle indices [1..168]
        - capacity_ah: measured capacity in Ah [1.856..1.288]
        - capacity_loss_ah: cumulative capacity loss Q_loss = Q_0 - Q
        - soh_ratio: State of Health ratio (Q / Q_0)
        - nominal_capacity_ah: Q_0
        """
        df = self._ensure_loaded()
        cycle_group = df.groupby("cycle")["capacity"].first().reset_index()
        cycles = cycle_group["cycle"].tolist()
        caps = [round(float(c), 4) for c in cycle_group["capacity"].tolist()]
        q0 = caps[0] if caps else 1.8565
        q_loss = [round(float(q0 - c), 4) for c in caps]
        soh = [round(float(c / q0), 4) for c in caps]

        return {
            "cycles": cycles,
            "capacity_ah": caps,
            "capacity_loss_ah": q_loss,
            "soh_ratio": soh,
            "nominal_capacity_ah": q0,
            "total_cycles": len(cycles)
        }

    def get_internal_resistance_series(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Estimates dynamic internal resistance R_0 = |Delta V / Delta I| per discharge cycle.
        Returns:
        - cycles: list of cycle indices
        - r0_ohms: internal resistance in Ohms
        - temp_c: ambient/initial temperature in Celsius
        """
        df = self._ensure_loaded()
        cycles = []
        r0_list = []
        temp_list = []

        for c_idx, group in df.groupby("cycle"):
            if len(group) < 5:
                continue
            v_init = group["voltage_measured"].iloc[0]
            v_loaded = group["voltage_measured"].iloc[min(3, len(group)-1)]
            i_init = group["current_measured"].iloc[0]
            i_loaded = group["current_measured"].iloc[min(3, len(group)-1)]
            temp = group["temperature_measured"].iloc[0]

            delta_i = abs(i_loaded - i_init)
            delta_v = abs(v_init - v_loaded)

            if delta_i > 0.1:
                r0 = delta_v / delta_i
                cycles.append(int(c_idx))
                r0_list.append(round(float(r0), 4))
                temp_list.append(round(float(temp), 2))

        return {
            "cycles": cycles,
            "r0_ohms": r0_list,
            "temperatures_c": temp_list,
            "mean_r0": round(float(np.mean(r0_list)), 4) if r0_list else 0.0
        }

    def get_thermal_rise_series(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Measures maximum cell temperature rise Delta T = T_max - T_ambient per cycle.
        """
        df = self._ensure_loaded()
        cycles = []
        delta_t_list = []

        for c_idx, group in df.groupby("cycle"):
            t_amb = group["ambient_temperature"].iloc[0]
            t_max = group["temperature_measured"].max()
            delta_t = t_max - t_amb
            cycles.append(int(c_idx))
            delta_t_list.append(round(float(delta_t), 2))

        return {
            "cycles": cycles,
            "delta_t_c": delta_t_list,
            "max_rise": round(float(max(delta_t_list)), 2) if delta_t_list else 0.0
        }

    def get_discharge_curve(self, cycle_num: int = 1) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Returns high-frequency discharge curve (V, I, T vs time) for a specific cycle.
        """
        df = self._ensure_loaded()
        sub = df[df["cycle"] == cycle_num].sort_values("time")
        if sub.empty:
            sub = df[df["cycle"] == 1].sort_values("time")

        return {
            "cycle": cycle_num,
            "time_sec": sub["time"].tolist(),
            "voltage": [round(float(v), 4) for v in sub["voltage_measured"].tolist()],
            "current": [round(float(i), 4) for i in sub["current_measured"].tolist()],
            "temperature": [round(float(t), 2) for t in sub["temperature_measured"].tolist()],
            "capacity": float(sub["capacity"].iloc[0])
        }

if __name__ == "__main__":
    loader = NasaBatteryLoader()
    fade = loader.get_capacity_fade_series()
    print(f"Loaded NASA B0005: {fade['total_cycles']} cycles. Initial Q={fade['capacity_ah'][0]} Ah, Final Q={fade['capacity_ah'][-1]} Ah")
    r0 = loader.get_internal_resistance_series()
    print(f"Internal resistance evaluated across {len(r0['cycles'])} cycles. Mean R0 = {r0['mean_r0']} Ohms")
    therm = loader.get_thermal_rise_series()
    print(f"Thermal generation evaluated across {len(therm['cycles'])} cycles. Max Delta T = {therm['max_rise']} C")

"""
PRIME-Scout: SQLite Persistence & Memory Vault
Stores tracked repositories, evaluation telemetry, sandbox execution logs,
experiments, agent questions, and two-way chat history.
"""

import sqlite3
import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Optional, Dict, Any, List, Tuple
from scout.config import DB_PATH

def get_connection() -> sqlite3.Connection:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    return conn

def init_db():
    conn = get_connection()
    cur = conn.cursor()
    
    cur.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS repositories (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        repo_url TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
        name TEXT NOT NULL,
        full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
        owner TEXT NOT NULL,
        description TEXT,
        stars INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        forks INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        language TEXT,
        topics TEXT,
        created_at TEXT,
        updated_at TEXT,
        discovered_at TEXT,
        status TEXT DEFAULT "DISCOVERED"
    );
    """)
    
    cur.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS evaluations (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        repo_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        evaluated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        viability_score INTEGER NOT NULL,
        alignment_score INTEGER NOT NULL,
        verdict TEXT NOT NULL,
        executive_pitch TEXT,
        technical_critique TEXT,
        synergy_notes TEXT,
        sandbox_status TEXT DEFAULT "SKIPPED",
        sandbox_log TEXT,
        FOREIGN KEY (repo_id) REFERENCES repositories(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    );
    """)
    
    cur.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS briefings (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        briefing_date TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
        report_path TEXT NOT NULL,
        summary TEXT,
        repo_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        created_at TEXT
    );
    """)

    cur.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chat_messages (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        sender TEXT NOT NULL,
        content TEXT NOT NULL,
        context_repo_id INTEGER,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL
    );
    """)

    cur.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_questions (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        repo_id INTEGER,
        repo_name TEXT,
        question TEXT NOT NULL,
        status TEXT DEFAULT "PENDING",
        user_answer TEXT,
        asked_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        answered_at TEXT
    );
    """)

    cur.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS experiments (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        repo_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        experiment_name TEXT NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL,
        telemetry TEXT,
        stdout TEXT,
        stderr TEXT,
        executed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        FOREIGN KEY (repo_id) REFERENCES repositories(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    );
    """)

    cur.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS theories (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        title TEXT NOT NULL,
        hypothesis TEXT NOT NULL,
        target_repo_name TEXT,
        target_repo_url TEXT,
        motivation TEXT,
        synthesized_code TEXT,
        status TEXT DEFAULT "PENDING",
        telemetry TEXT,
        empirical_conclusion TEXT,
        synergy_notes TEXT,
        discovered_equation TEXT,
        equation_r2 REAL,
        parent_theory_id INTEGER,
        branch_type TEXT DEFAULT "FRONTIER_SEED",
        variables_json TEXT DEFAULT '["X1"]',
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        completed_at TEXT
    );
    """)

    # Dynamic schema migration for theories table
    cur.execute("PRAGMA table_info(theories);")
    existing_cols = [r[1] for r in cur.fetchall()]
    if "parent_theory_id" not in existing_cols:
        cur.execute("ALTER TABLE theories ADD COLUMN parent_theory_id INTEGER;")
    if "branch_type" not in existing_cols:
        cur.execute("ALTER TABLE theories ADD COLUMN branch_type TEXT DEFAULT 'FRONTIER_SEED';")
    if "variables_json" not in existing_cols:
        cur.execute("ALTER TABLE theories ADD COLUMN variables_json TEXT DEFAULT '[\"X1\"]';")
    if "domain" not in existing_cols:
        cur.execute("ALTER TABLE theories ADD COLUMN domain TEXT DEFAULT 'ARCHITECTURE';")


    cur.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS autonomous_state (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
        is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
        current_action TEXT DEFAULT 'IDLE',
        current_target TEXT DEFAULT 'None',
        cycles_completed INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        theories_generated INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        tests_executed INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        last_pulse TEXT
    );
    """)

    # Ensure singleton autonomous_state row exists
    now_str = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    cur.execute("""
    INSERT OR IGNORE INTO autonomous_state (id, is_active, current_action, current_target, cycles_completed, theories_generated, tests_executed, last_pulse)
    VALUES (1, 1, 'INITIALIZING', 'Starting up autonomous lab...', 0, 0, 0, ?);
    """, (now_str,))
    
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()

def upsert_repository(repo: Dict[str, Any]) -> int:
    conn = get_connection()
    cur = conn.cursor()
    now_str = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    topics_json = json.dumps(repo.get("topics", []))
    
    cur.execute("""
    INSERT INTO repositories (repo_url, name, full_name, owner, description, stars, forks, language, topics, created_at, updated_at, discovered_at, status)
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    ON CONFLICT(repo_url) DO UPDATE SET
        stars=excluded.stars,
        forks=excluded.forks,
        description=excluded.description,
        updated_at=excluded.updated_at
    RETURNING id;
    """, (
        repo["repo_url"],
        repo.get("name", ""),
        repo.get("full_name", ""),
        repo.get("owner", ""),
        repo.get("description", ""),
        repo.get("stars", 0),
        repo.get("forks", 0),
        repo.get("language", ""),
        topics_json,
        repo.get("created_at", now_str),
        repo.get("updated_at", now_str),
        now_str,
        repo.get("status", "DISCOVERED")
    ))
    
    row = cur.fetchone()
    repo_id = row[0]
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return repo_id

def record_theory(
    title: str,
    hypothesis: str,
    target_repo_name: str,
    target_repo_url: str,
    motivation: str,
    synthesized_code: str,
    synergy_notes: str = "",
    parent_theory_id: Optional[int] = None,
    branch_type: str = "FRONTIER_SEED",
    variables: Optional[List[str]] = None,
    domain: str = "BATTERY_PHYSICS"
) -> int:
    conn = get_connection()
    cur = conn.cursor()
    now_str = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    vars_json = json.dumps(variables or ["X1"])
    cur.execute("""
    INSERT INTO theories (
        title, hypothesis, target_repo_name, target_repo_url, motivation,
        synthesized_code, status, synergy_notes, parent_theory_id, branch_type,
        variables_json, domain, created_at
    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'PENDING', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    RETURNING id;
    """, (title, hypothesis, target_repo_name, target_repo_url, motivation, synthesized_code, synergy_notes, parent_theory_id, branch_type, vars_json, domain, now_str))
    theory_id = cur.fetchone()[0]
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return theory_id

    affected = cur.rowcount

    conn.close()

def get_autonomous_state() -> Dict[str, Any]:
    conn = get_connection()
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.execute("SELECT id, is_active, current_action, current_target, cycles_completed, theories_generated, tests_executed, last_pulse FROM autonomous_state WHERE id = 1")
    row = cur.fetchone()
    conn.close()
    if not row:
        return {
            "is_active": 1,
            "current_action": "IDLE",
            "current_target": "None",
            "cycles_completed": 0,
            "theories_generated": 0,
            "tests_executed": 0,
            "last_pulse": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
        }
    return dict(row)

def update_autonomous_state(
    is_active: Optional[int] = None,
    current_action: Optional[str] = None,
    current_target: Optional[str] = None,
    increment_cycles: bool = False,
    increment_theories: bool = False,
    increment_tests: bool = False
):
    conn = get_connection()
    cur = conn.cursor()
    now_str = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    
    updates = ["last_pulse = ?"]
    params = [now_str]
    
    if is_active is not None:
        updates.append("is_active = ?")
        params.append(is_active)
    if current_action is not None:
        updates.append("current_action = ?")
        params.append(current_action)
    if current_target is not None:
        updates.append("current_target = ?")
        params.append(current_target)
    if increment_cycles:
        updates.append("cycles_completed = cycles_completed + 1")
    if increment_theories:
        updates.append("theories_generated = theories_generated + 1")
    if increment_tests:
        updates.append("tests_executed = tests_executed + 1")
        
    query = f"UPDATE autonomous_state SET {', '.join(updates)} WHERE id = 1"
    cur.execute(query, tuple(params))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()

def export_dataset_json(out_path: str = None) -> str:
    if out_path is None:
        out_path = str(DATASET_DIR / "romantasy_train.json")

    raw_samples = build_curated_samples()
    formatted = []

    for s in raw_samples:
        text = (
            f"<|start_header_id|>system<|end_header_id|>\n\n"
            f"You are a master commercial dark romantasy author specializing in high-heat, psychological obsession, razor-sharp dialogue, and multi-sensory immersion (5/5 heat level).\n"
            f"Write exclusively in visceral, third-person limited prose. Never summarize. Never write author notes.<|eot_id|>\n"
            f"<|start_header_id|>user<|end_header_id|>\n\n"
            f"{s['instruction']}<|eot_id|>\n"
            f"<|start_header_id|>assistant<|end_header_id|>\n\n"
            f"{s['completion']}<|eot_id|>"
        )
        formatted.append({"text": text, "instruction": s["instruction"], "completion": s["completion"]})

    with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(formatted, f, indent=2)

    print(f"[✓] [Dataset] Exported {len(formatted)} training samples to {out_path}")
    return out_path


if __name__ == "__main__":
    export_dataset_json()

"""
Model Downloader for Stheno-v3.2
================================
Downloads Sao10K/L3-8B-Stheno-v3.2 into the local HuggingFace cache.
"""

import sys
import time
from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download

MODEL_ID = "Sao10K/L3-8B-Stheno-v3.2"

def main():
    print(f"[*] Starting download of {MODEL_ID} (safetensors & config)...")
    t0 = time.time()
    try:
        path = snapshot_download(
            repo_id=MODEL_ID,
            repo_type="model",
            allow_patterns=["*.safetensors", "*.json"],
            max_workers=4
        )
        elapsed = time.time() - t0
        print(f"\n[✓] Successfully downloaded {MODEL_ID} to {path} in {elapsed:.1f}s")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"\n[✗] Download failed: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""
Batch Editorial Polish Sweep for Romantasy / Romance Catalog
============================================================
Runs the Sovereign Copy Editor across all completed romance titles:
- a_crown_of_gilded_bones
- tethered_in_smoke_and_sin
- the_serpent_and_the_star_thief
- beneath_the_ashen_sun
"""

import sys
import json
import sqlite3
import pathlib
from datetime import datetime, timezone

PROJECT_ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(PROJECT_ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT_ROOT))

from scout.prime_copy_editor import PrimeCopyEditor

ROMANCE_SLUGS = [
    "a_crown_of_gilded_bones",
    "tethered_in_smoke_and_sin",
    "the_serpent_and_the_star_thief",
    "beneath_the_ashen_sun"
]

def main():
    editor = PrimeCopyEditor()
    catalog_results = []

    print("=" * 80)
    print("🌹 PRIME Sovereign Editor: Romance & Romantasy Catalog Sweep")
    print("=" * 80)

    for slug in ROMANCE_SLUGS:
        try:
            res = editor.edit_novel_batch(slug, apply_fix=True)
            catalog_results.append(res)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"[!] Error sweeping {slug}: {e}")

    print("\n" + "=" * 80)
    print("✨ ALL ROMANCE NOVELS POLISHED & TYPESET!")
    print("=" * 80)
    for r in catalog_results:
        print(f"📚 {r['slug']:32s} | Chapters: {r['chapters_scanned']:2d} | Issues Fixed: {r['total_issues_fixed']:2d} | PDF: {pathlib.Path(r['pdf_generated']).name}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
